named_mechanism: Hybrid MARL-guided Large Neighborhood Search for MAPF
exact_ideal_definition: train/use multi-agent RL policy to reduce collisions in early LNS destroy/repair stages
use Large Neighborhood Search to choose subsets of agents and replan them
use prioritized planning as efficient late-stage/local repair
validate vertex and edge-swap collision freedom

implemented_steps.LNS loop with destroy/repair neighborhoo: yes: lns_repair selects a subset, removes their paths, replans with reservations
implemented_steps.MARL component: approximated: policy-guided multi-agent neighborhood scoring uses conflict, excess-length, path-distance, and bottleneck-density features; no neural MARL training was possible in the bounded benchmark
implemented_steps.prioritized planning repair: yes: space-time A* against vertex/edge reservations replans selected agents sequentially
implemented_steps.collision validator: yes: detect_collisions checks vertex and swap collisions at all timesteps

deviations: No external MARL environment or pretrained policy existed in workspace; implemented a transparent MARL-inspired decentralized conflict-pressure policy instead of training deep MARL online.
Input datasets contained maps only, so starts/goals were generated deterministically from free cells.
invariants: reported success requires all agents planned and zero vertex/swap collisions
